title: pytest-runner is deprecated
summary: The maintainer warns that pytest-runner depends on deprecated Setuptools features and can bypass pip security mechanisms.
replacement: tox, nox, or direct pytest invocation

constraints: Preserve test dependencies, pytest options, environment variables, supported Python versions, and CI exit behavior.

steps.title: Remove pytest-runner
steps.instructions: Remove pytest-runner from setup requirements and move test dependencies out of tests_require.

steps.title: Add an explicit test runner
steps.instructions: Configure tox, nox, or the existing environment manager to install test dependencies and invoke pytest directly.

verification.purpose: Run the test suite without setup.py test or pytest-runner.
